description: This file defines the StorageMemoryPool class responsible for managing an adjustable-size memory pool used for storage (caching) in Apache Spark. It includes methods for acquiring, releasing, and shrinking memory, as well as handling memory store initialization and eviction.

classes.name: StorageMemoryPool
classes.description: Manages a memory pool for storage in Spark, supporting memory acquisition, release, and shrinking operations, with synchronization and eviction handling.

methods.name: setMemoryStore
methods.description: Sets the MemoryStore used for evicting cached blocks.

methods.name: acquireMemory
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a specified number of bytes for a block, evicting existing blocks if necessary.

methods.name: acquireMemory
methods.description: Overloaded method that acquires memory for a block, considering space to free.

methods.name: releaseMemory
methods.description: Releases a specified amount of memory, updating internal counters.

methods.name: releaseAllMemory
methods.description: Releases all memory held by the pool.

methods.name: freeSpaceToShrinkPool
methods.description: Calculates space to free to shrink the pool, evicting blocks if needed.
